biblio.label: U.S. Patent Application Publication No. US 2025/0319560 A1
biblio.title: Magnetic coupling device with at least one of a sensor arrangement and a degauss capability
biblio.abstract: Magnetic coupling devices are disclosed having magnetic field sensors. The magnetic coupling device may include a calibration module for calibrating the magnetic coupling devices.

summary: This document discloses a magnetic system for moving a ferromagnetic workpiece, which includes magnetic coupling devices, magnetic field sensors, and a calibration module.

rows.label: claim 1[a]
rows.claim_text: A magnetic gripper for gripping a ferromagnetic workpiece, said magnetic gripper comprising
rows.claim_paraphrase: A magnetic gripper for gripping a ferromagnetic workpiece, said magnetic gripper comprising
rows.quote: A magnetic system for moving a ferromagnetic workpiece, the magnetic system comprising: a machine including a base and an arm having a plurality of arm segments, a first end of the plurality of arm segments being opposite the base; a
rows.note: The reference describes a 'magnetic system for moving a ferromagnetic workpiece' which includes 'magnetic coupling devices' configured to 'engage the ferromagnetic workpiece', which is equivalent to a magnetic gripper for gripping a ferromagnetic workpiece.
rows.disclosure: The reference discloses a "magnetic system for moving a ferromagnetic workpiece" which includes "magnetic coupling devices" configured to "engage the ferromagnetic workpiece".

rows.label: claim 1[b]
rows.claim_text: a magnet which is arranged in the housing and which is displaceable along a displacement direction between a gripping position for gripping the ferromagnetic workpiece and a release position for releasing the ferromagnetic workpiece
rows.claim_paraphrase: a magnet which is arranged in the housing and which is displaceable along a displacement direction between a gripping position for gripping the ferromagnetic workpiece and a …
rows.quote: The magnetic system of claim 1, wherein the at least first permanent magnet is moveable relative to the housing.
rows.note: The reference teaches that the permanent magnet is moveable relative to the housing, which implies it can be displaced between a gripping and release position.
rows.disclosure: The reference discloses that the "at least first permanent magnet is moveable relative to the housing".

rows.label: claim 1[c]
rows.claim_text: a number of pole shoes attached to the housing, wherein each pole shoe has a workpiece contact surface and is designed to guide a magnetic field portion of the magnet to the workpiece contact surface
rows.claim_paraphrase: a number of pole shoes attached to the housing, wherein each pole shoe has a workpiece contact surface and is designed to guide a magnetic field portion of the magnet to the …
rows.quote: a plurality of workpiece engagement surfaces supported by the housing and magnetically coupled to the magnetic flux source, the plurality of workpiece engagement surfaces adapted to contact the ferromagnetic workpiece, a first workpiece engagement surface of the plurality of workpiece
rows.note: The reference describes 'workpiece engagement surfaces' that are 'magnetically coupled to the magnetic flux source' and 'adapted to contact the ferromagnetic workpiece', which are equivalent to pole shoes with workpiece contact surfaces designed to guide a magnetic field portion.
rows.disclosure: The reference discloses "a plurality of workpiece engagement surfaces supported by the housing and magnetically coupled to the magnetic flux source, the plurality of workpiece engagement surfaces adapted to contact the ferromagnetic workpiece".

rows.label: claim 8[a]
rows.claim_text: The magnetic gripper according to claim 1, wherein the number of pole shoes includes a first pole shoe and a second pole shoe
rows.claim_paraphrase: The magnetic gripper according to claim 1, wherein the number of pole shoes includes a first pole shoe and a second pole shoe
rows.quote: a first workpiece engagement surface of the plurality of workpiece engagement surfaces corresponding to a north pole of the magnetic coupling device and a second workpiece engagement surface of the plurality of workpiece engagement surfaces corresponding to a south pole
rows.note: The reference teaches that the workpiece engagement surfaces correspond to north and south poles, which is equivalent to pole shoes.
rows.disclosure: The reference discloses "a first workpiece engagement surface of the plurality of workpiece engagement surfaces corresponding to a north pole of the magnetic coupling device and a second workpiece engagement surface of the plurality of workpiece engagement surfaces corresponding to a south pole".

rows.label: claim 9[a]
rows.claim_text: The magnetic gripper according to claim 1, wherein the magnet is displaceable electrically, pneumatically, or mechanically between the gripping position and the release position
rows.claim_paraphrase: The magnetic gripper according to claim 1, wherein the magnet is displaceable electrically, pneumatically, or mechanically between the gripping position and the release position
rows.quote: further comprising an actuator operably coupled to the magnetic platter, the actuator operable to translate the magnetic platter relative to the housing.
rows.note: The reference discloses an actuator to translate the magnetic platter (which includes the permanent magnet) relative to the housing
rows.disclosure: The reference discloses "an actuator operably coupled to the magnetic platter, the actuator operable to translate the magnetic platter relative to the housing".

rows.label: claim 10[b]
rows.claim_text: the magnetic gripper has a workpiece sensor for detecting the ferromagnetic workpiece
rows.claim_paraphrase: the magnetic gripper has a workpiece sensor for detecting the ferromagnetic workpiece
rows.quote: the controller configured to determine a status of each of the first magnetic coupling device and the second magnetic coupling device relative to the ferromagnetic workpiece.
rows.note: The reference discloses a controller determining the status of the magnetic coupling device relative to the workpiece, which implies detecting the workpiece
rows.disclosure: The reference discloses "the controller configured to determine a status of each of the first magnetic coupling device and the second magnetic coupling device relative to the ferromagnetic workpiece".

rows.label: claim 14[a]
rows.claim_text: A magnetic gripper system, the magnetic gripper system comprising
rows.claim_paraphrase: A magnetic gripper system, the magnetic gripper system comprising
rows.quote: A magnetic system for moving a ferromagnetic workpiece, the magnetic system comprising: a machine including a base and an arm having a plurality of arm segments
